caption: The worked example as one chain: a 4096-element, 12-bit line sensor scanning 3000 rows at 400 rows/s builds 12,288,000 pixels and 147,456,000 bits, which is 18,432,000 bytes. Notice the last two blocks: the same buffer is 18.432 MB in decimal units and 17.578 MiB in binary units, and the whole scan takes 7.5 s.

spec.title: Line sensor scan: worked example
spec.aria: A 4096-element, 12-bit line sensor scanning 3000 rows at 400 rows per second gives 12,288,000 pixels, then 147,456,000 bits, then 18,432,000 bytes, which is 18.432 MB or 17.578 MiB, and the scan takes 7.5 seconds.
